blind.description: An inverted V-shaped section of thatched roof ridge capping. It features a rounded top crest and sloping sides textured like bundled golden-brown straw or thatch. Each long side has a scalloped lower trim and decorative dark-brown criss-cross/lattice strapping running along its length. The geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with stylized hand-painted textures, resting flat on the ground with no plinth.
blind.from_above: An elongated rectangular cap with a rounded central spine running lengthwise, flanked by sloping straw-textured sides edged with repeating dark cross-ties and scalloped borders.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/10 the height of the figure (around 6-8 inches high), about 1/3 the figure's height in length (around 2 feet long).
